matches.text: When wiring any adapter boolean the SDK's own render logic branches on (e.g. `mobileMenuOpen`, `memberListOpen`), verify the exact field name against the live `247420.js` bundle (`curl` + grep) rather than assuming a same-named zellous action drives the right signal — it's easy to have an action that only touches dead legacy DOM while the real signal stays unwired.
